prova:
intro k hk
  have h : ∀ n, n ∈ {n | ∀ i ∈ Set.Icc 1 k, φ n = φ (n + i)} := by
    intro n
    intro i hi
    have : φ n = φ (n + i) := by
      have h1 : φ n ≤ n := Nat.totient_le_self n
      have h2 : φ (n + i) ≤ n + i := Nat.totient_le_self (n + i)
      have h3 : 1 ≤ i := by
        have : i ∈ Set.Icc 1 k := hi
        exact (Set.mem_Icc.mp this).1
      have h4 : i ≤ k := by
        have : i ∈ Set.Icc 1 k := hi
        exact (Set.mem_Icc.mp this).2
      have h5 : 1 ≤ k := hk
      have h6 : 1 ≤ n + i := by
        omega
      have h7 : φ n = φ (n + i) := by
        have h8 : ¬ Nat.Prime (n + i) := by
          by_contra h8
          have h9 : Nat.Prime (n + i) := h8
          have h10 : n + i ∣ n := by
            have h11 : Nat.gcd (n + i) n = i := by
              rw [Nat.gcd_comm]
              have h12 : Nat.gcd n (n + i) = Nat.gcd n i := by
                rw [Nat.gcd_comm]
                rw [Nat.gcd_comm]
                rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
                apply Nat.gcd_eq_right
                omega
              rw [h12]
              have h13 : i ∣ n := by
                have h14 : i ≤ k := h4
                have h15 : 1 ≤ i := h3
                have h16 : i ∣ n := by
                  by_contra h16
                  have h17 : ¬ i ∣ n := h16
                  have h18 : Nat.gcd n i = 1 := by
                    have h19 : Nat.gcd n i = 1 := by
                      apply Nat.coprime_of_prime_of_not_dvd h9
                      intro h19
                      have h20 : i ∣ n := h19
                      contradiction
                    exact h19
                  have h21 : Nat.gcd n i = 1 := h18
                  have h22 : n + i > i := by omega
                  have h23 : (n + i) ∣ n := by
                    exact Nat.dvd_of_eq_of_eq (by omega) (by omega)
                  contradiction
                exact h16
              have h24 : Nat.gcd n i = i := by
                rw [Nat.dvd_gcd_iff (by omega) (by omega)]
                exact ⟨by omega, h13⟩
              rw [h24]
              exact h13
            have h25 : Nat.gcd (n + i) n = i := h11
            have h26 : Nat.Prime (n + i) := h9
            have h27 : Nat.gcd (n + i) n = 1 := by
              have h28 : Nat.gcd (n + i) n = 1 := by
                apply Nat.coprime_of_prime_of_not_dvd h26
                intro h28
                have h29 : (n + i) ∣ n := h28
                have h30 : n + i > n := by omega
                have h31 : ¬ (n + i) ∣ n := Nat.not_dvd_of_lt h30 (by omega)
                contradiction
              exact h28
            have h32 : i = 1 := by
              rw [← h25]
              exact h27
            have h33 : i = 1 := h32
            have h34 : 1 ≤ i := h3
            have h35 : i ≤ k := h4
            have h36 : 1 ≤ k := hk
            contradiction
          contradiction
        exact h7
      exact h7
    exact this
  exact Set.infinite_of_forall_mem_infinite h
